answer: One concrete defense: gate every new identity behind a global issuance beacon that releases only a fixed trickle of registration slots per block, like water seeping through shale. An honest agent waits one drip and is admitted. A clone-farm wanting ten thousand identities must queue through that same narrow canyon of slots, bleeding real wall-clock time it cannot fast-forward; the issuance rate, not the attacker hardware, caps how fast fakes appear. A vote-stuffing quorum that needs its majority now simply cannot be minted in time, so the sudden sybil flood never forms.
